errors.text: The proposed SPD-plus-annealing route does not reconstruct the high-energy ball milling followed by spark plasma sintering route.
No alloy composition, deformation magnitude, annealing temperature, or phase fractions are specified, so the proposed processing window and dual-phase constitution are not testably defined.
The assertion that sluggish diffusion stabilizes the dual-phase solid solution and suppresses intermetallics is unsupported and is not a reliable general property of multi-principal element alloys.
No prior evidence is cited despite the explicit request to support grain-refinement and phase-stability claims.

The falsification experiment does not distinguish grain-boundary strengthening from simple solid-solution strengthening because grain size, defect density, composition, and phase constitution are not independently controlled.
